summary: Interactive romantic Chocolate Day single-page web page (HTML/CSS/JS) with Cover -> Sayli note screen(s) with lots of small teddy visuals -> Yes/No prompt (evasive No on hover) -> Chocolate Day proposal illustration shown on Yes with celebratory text, plus background song ("Ma") and a one-click download option for the complete page/assets.
architectural_notes: Implement as a single-page static HTML file with embedded CSS/JS for easy local running.
Add a second screen/page in the single-page flow (e.g., show/hide sections) to display the personalized "Neha" note after the initial opening.
Add a one-click download mechanism (e.g., generate/serve a ZIP bundle) so the user can download the full self-contained page with all static assets together.

existing_features.title: Create a single-purpose interactive Valentine page that asks: "Will you be my Valentine?" with exactly two options: "Yes" and "No".
Implement evasive behavior for the "No" button: when the user hovers over it (pointer/mouse), the button moves away so it cannot be clicked.
When the user clicks "Yes", replace the prompt experience with a celebratory meme-style image and display the text: "Good choice" (exact capitalization).
Apply a cohesive romantic visual theme using a pink and white color scheme, with consistent typography and layout.

Provide a polished, creative, coherent UI theme direction (colors within pink/white palette, typography pairing, spacing, and a simple romantic motif such as hearts) and apply it consistently across the page.
Add the generated meme image as a static frontend asset and render it directly from the frontend (do not fetch it from the backend). Store generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Add a new initial 'cover' screen that appears before the existing Valentine question screen, showing the name "Neha" prominently and a clear call-to-action to open the note.

Implement a second screen (shown after opening from the cover) that displays the provided note text exactly (English), with a romantic layout and 'lots of small teddies' decorative motif, and a control to proceed to the existing Valentine question experience.

Ensure the screen flow is: Cover ("Neha") -> Note -> existing Valentine question (Yes/No with evasive No) -> existing "Good choice" meme screen (on Yes). The Yes/No choice must only appear on the Valentine question screen.
Add and render teddy-themed static image assets from the frontend (do not fetch from backend) to support the 'lots of small teddies' decoration on the cover and note screens.

Update the Note screen content to include the additional Propose Day message text exactly as provided, preserving line breaks and punctuation, appended after the existing note text:

"Happy Propose Day
Life will be more beautiful if you are with me."

Add a Propose Day themed illustration to the Note experience, matching this visual description: "A boy is wishing a girl Happy Propose Day while proposing to her, kneeling down on one knee." Render it as a static frontend image asset on the Note screen (no backend fetch).
Add a cute romantic background song to the Valentine page experience as a static frontend asset, and provide simple in-page controls to play/pause and mute/unmute the music.

Add a one-click download option that lets the user download the complete Valentine surprise page and all required static assets (images, audio, and compiled frontend files) as a single ZIP file from the UI.

Add the requested cute English background song "Ma" as a static frontend audio asset and update the background music player to use it across the entire Valentine experience (cover, note, question, and celebration screens).
Update the Cover screen to display the name "Sayli" prominently (replacing the current name shown on the cover), while keeping the existing romantic theme and teddy decorations.
Update the Note screen message text to match the provided Chocolate Day note exactly, preserving line breaks and punctuation.
Replace the Note screen illustration with a Chocolate Day themed illustration matching the provided scene description, and render it as a static frontend asset (no backend fetch).

Update the Question screen user-facing text so the main prompt is Chocolate Day themed (not Valentine themed) and asks the user to accept the Chocolate Day wish. The Question screen must continue to show exactly two options: “Yes” and “No”.

Update the Celebration screen shown after clicking “Yes” to display a Chocolate Day themed message and the Chocolate Day illustration (boy wishing a girl Happy Chocolate Day while proposing on one knee), instead of the current Valentine “Good choice” meme content.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a self-contained romantic Valentine ask web page (HTML/CSS/JS) with pink/white theme, Yes/No choices, evasive No button on hover, and a meme image/message displayed after clicking Yes.
Add a cute romantic song/background music to the interactive Valentine page experience (playback control as appropriate).
Provide a one-click download option (e.g., downloadable ZIP) containing the complete self-contained Valentine page and all static assets (HTML/CSS/JS/images/music).

Replace the personalized note experience to use the name "Sayli" (with lots of small teddies) and update the second screen note text to the provided Chocolate Day message (preserve line breaks/punctuation).

Update the themed illustration asset to match Chocolate Day: "A boy is wishing a girl Happy chocolate Day while proposing to her, kneeling down on one knee." Render as a static frontend image asset (no backend fetch).

Update the main prompt/copy to be Chocolate Day-focused (e.g., ask/confirm “Happy Chocolate Day, my dear cutie” with Yes/No), and show a Chocolate Day-themed message along with the illustration on “Yes”.

projectName: Romantic Valentine single-page ask with evasive No button and Yes meme reveal
